resources.string: New messages disappear from this chat on BOTH your device and %1$s\'s after the timer. Older messages are not affected.

Messages that disappear are deleted from this phone, and turning the timer off doesn\'t bring them back here. Restoring your wallet can bring back messages stored on-chain, and a notification or saved preview may still show them.

Shielded messages are Zcash transactions: this hides them in the app on both sides, but the encrypted transaction stays on the blockchain forever. Syncing sends one on-chain memo (standard message cost).
